# `sandloom.sdk`: the Python API

Sandloom Public API 1.0: the one namespace business modules import (spec §2).

A business module and its tests import only public `sandloom.sdk` modules (no
leading underscore), generated contract stubs and contract DTOs, and their
own package. This root re-exports the beginner code names; every other
public name lives in its themed module:

`sandloom.sdk.module`, `.app`, `.migrations`, `.tooling`, `.web`,
`.data`, `.tenant`, `.events`, `.effects`, `.tasks`, `.contracts`,
`.authz`, `.sagas`, `.projections`, `.infra`, `.security`,
`.errors`, `.testing` (and `.testing.fixtures`).

Importing `sandloom.sdk` reads no environment and performs no I/O (spec §2.4,
`test_sdk_import_is_side_effect_free`). Layers (spec §3): the public
modules > `sandloom.sdk._decl` (L1, declarative) > `sandloom.sdk._prim` (L2
primitives); the kernel never imports `sandloom.sdk` (`.importlinter`).

Start with the beginner names below. The themed modules also expose
advanced primitives for explicit transaction, event and deployment needs.
Run `sandloom docs <name>` for a name's signature and usage.

## Levels

Level 1 (declarative: `define_module` discovery, `module_router`, `Event`, `on`, `contract`, `command`, `Contract`, typed saga steps, `Projection`) is built only from level 2 (the primitives these pages list as advanced). The kernel (level 3) is never imported by a module. See [Modules, levels and discovery](../../concepts/modules.md).
